title: A change after the work order was invoiced in another tab is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, another customer to try as Bill To.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B.
  • Open work order 1 in two browser tabs.
custom_steps:
1. In the first tab, expand the Customer card.
  2. Switch to the second tab.
  3. Open the Finance tab.
  4. Click Create Invoice.
  5. Switch to the first tab.
  6. Click the Bill To field.
  7. Pick customer C in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 2:

  • The second tab shows work order 1 for customer A.

Step 3:

  • The Finance tab shows Create Invoice.

Step 4:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 5:

  • The first tab still shows the field as changeable.

Step 6:

  • The list opens (the page has not refreshed).

Step 7:

  • The change is refused with "Invoiced. Reverse the invoice to change who's billed."
  • The field refreshes to its locked state, still reading customer B's name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-E1: “If the document is invoiced while the page is open, a change is refused with M4 and the field refreshes to its locked state.”
